candidates.name: Internal herniation
support_spans: A cluster of small-bowel loops in the left upper quadrant, positioned anterior to the splenic flexure.
The central mesenteric vessels exhibited a spiral (whirl) pattern, with congestion of mesenteric fat and stretching and convergence of vessels.
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with internal herniation, which can cause bowel obstruction and abdominal pain.

candidates.name: Adhesive bowel obstruction
support_spans: The patient had undergone multiple abdominal surgeries, which increases the risk of adhesive bowel obstruction.

candidates.why: The patient's history of multiple abdominal surgeries and symptoms of bowel obstruction make adhesive bowel obstruction a possible diagnosis.
